newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dealers protest car prices at Paris show.
newsitem.headline: Dealers protest car prices at Paris show.

text.p: More than 2,500 dealers staged a protest at the Paris car show on Thursday to demand uniform car prices throughout Europe.
"One Europe, one car, one price," was the slogan of the demonstration organised by the National Council of Automotive Professions CNPA.
Dealers complain that disparities in prices, which vary up to 20 percent in European Union countries and tend to be on the high end in France, cut into their ability to make profits.
The council said in a statement that it would present proposals soon to France's carmakers and to the government.
